title: Technology Sector Update for 11/20/2018: ADI,PSTG,INTU
text:

Technology stocks declined again today, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were losing almost 2.4% in value although the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose just under 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Analog Devices ( ADI ) was almost 4% higher in late Tuesday trading after the specialty chipmaker reported improved fiscal Q4 net income and revenue compared with the same quarter last year and also exceeding Wall Street expectations. Excluding one-time items, it earned $1.55 per share, up from $1.45 per share last year and topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share, Revenue rose to $1.6 billion from $1.54 billion during the year-ago period and also surpassing the $1.57 billion Street view.
In other sector news:
(+) Pure Storage ( PSTG ) rose over 3% on Tuesday after the data storage company reported better-than-expected fiscal Q3 results, including non-GAAP net income of $0.13 per share, improving on a $0.04 per share adjusted profit during the year-ago period and topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.04 per share. Revenue climbed 34% year-over-year to $372.8 million, also exceeding the $367.4 million analyst mean.
(-) Intuit's ( INTU ) was down almost 3% on Tuesday despite the software company reporting non-GAAP Q1 net income of $0.29 per share, climbing from $0.17 per share during the year-earlier quarter and more than doubling the Capital IQ consensus expecting $0.11 per share. Revenue rose to $1.02 billion from $910 million a year ago, also exceeding the $971.45 million estimate.
